stem: Three containers are received, one is held and one has an unresolved quantity discrepancy. What is the truthful work status?
choices: Mark the entire harvest complete because most containers were received normally.
Mark the whole harvest failed because one held and one discrepant container remain unresolved.
Record the normal receipts separately and show the held and discrepant containers as unresolved partial completion.
Remove the exception containers from the summary so the status reflects only completed work.
rationale: Truthful status should distinguish completed work from unresolved exceptions. Normal receipts can be closed while the held and quantity-discrepant containers remain open. Collapsing everything into complete or failed hides the actual state and makes the next shift's responsibilities unclear.
